answer_2.quote: We adopt the averaged micro-F1 score as the evaluation metric and also report the logical inconsistency metric LI (defined in Section 2.2) on ERE datasets.

answer_4.quote: Annotators are asked to review 100 predictions generated by ChatGPT and mark the error types.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators label each prediction with error types such as CE1, CE2, CE3 (incorrectness to the constraint) or FE1, FE2 (unfaithfulness to the reasoning process).
